annotations.title: Check colour contrast for text and controls

description: Call when choosing or changing colours, a palette or design tokens, before they are used in a design or in code. Takes colour pairs (foreground and background, with text size in px and weight when the foreground is text, or use: "non-text" for control borders, icons and focus rings) or a set of named tokens, in hex, rgb() or hsl(). Returns each pair’s contrast ratio, pass or fail against WCAG 1.4.3 (text) and 1.4.11 (non-text) at AA or AAA, the nearest passing shade of the same hue, and the guides that apply. It checks values, not rendered pages: text over images, real focus states and forced colors stay with the audit.

level.description: Conformance level to check against (default AA)

locale.description: Language of the answer and the guides: en (default) or ja. Japanese answers cite JIS X 8341-3:2016.

foreground.description: Text, icon or border colour: #767676, rgb(118 118 118), hsl(0 0% 46%)

name.description: What the pair is, e.g. "body text", "primary button border"

size.description: Font size in CSS px, when the foreground is text

use.description: text (default), large-text, or non-text for control boundaries, icons and focus indicators (3:1)

weight.description: Font weight (400, 700), when the foreground is text

tokens.description: Or named tokens { "ink": "#1b1b1b", "paper": "#fff" }, up to 12; every combination is checked as text

name: check_palette
